steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Actioning: assigning a transitive verb to each line — 'I WARN', 'I BEG', 'I THREATEN' — gives every line a purpose and energy. | Key Fact: Vocal skills: pace, pitch, pause, volume, tone, emphasis, accent — each must be chosen deliberately for character and situation. | Key Fact: Physical skills: posture, gesture, facial expression, proxemics, eye contact, movement — the body communicates as much as the voice. | Key Fact: Line learning: learn lines EARLY so you can focus on delivery, not recall. Learn intention, not just words.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Explain what actioning is and how it helps an actor deliver lines more effectively. | Describe the vocal and physical skills you would use to perform a character experiencing a crisis of confidence. | How can an actor maintain truthfulness in performance without simply 'acting' emotions?
